run_extract_f0_pyaapt: run the extract_f0 script to extract fundamental frequency from WAV files using pYAAPT
run_extract_f0_interp: run the extract_f0 script with interpolation enabled to extract smoothed F0 values
run_extract_f0_workers: run the extract_f0 script with a custom number of parallel worker processes
extract_f0_function: extract fundamental frequency from a WAV audio file and save as numpy array
main_function: process a TSV file of WAV paths in parallel to extract F0 for each audio file
